cues.text: Welcome. You and a service robot work together in this restaurant. The robot normally handles food orders, and you handle drink orders.
The System panel tracks your score, both inventories, assigned tasks, and the robot's battery level.
The Dialogue panel records what customers and the robot are saying, so you can follow orders and robot activity.
Customer Orders shows active work in Live. History records completed and failed orders, including their score changes.
The center pop-up presents customer messages and robot requests. Here is an example of a robot request.
The progress bar follows the trial and the service day. Finish Day 1 with a score of zero or higher to win. Reaching minus thirty ends the game immediately.
That is the main setup. You are ready to begin the game!
